title: Contract Market Scale by Community (Community Rules & Site Care Regional Contract Schedule)
content:
The contract visit rate for a self-help cure under Community Rules & Site Care is scaled by the contract market of the community named on the Home-Site Lease.

| Community named on the Home-Site Lease | Contract market scale |
|---|---|
| Cedar Hollow | multiplied by 1.1 |
| Conestoga Meadows | multiplied by 1.1 |
| Bluebonnet Ridge | multiplied by 0.9 |
| Saguaro Vista | multiplied by 0.9 |
| Willow Bend Estates | not scaled |
| Palmetto Shores | not scaled |

The market scale is not limited to particular rule classes: it applies to lawn, debris and snow cures alike.

## Hypothetical illustration

A visit rate of $60.00, chosen for illustration:

| Community | Scaled visit rate |
|---|---|
| Conestoga Meadows | $66.00 |
| Saguaro Vista | $54.00 |
| Palmetto Shores | $60.00 |
